name: STA410H1 — Deductive Derivation (Monte Carlo Methods)
description: Monte Carlo: estimate θ=E[f(X)] by θ̂=(1/n)Σf(Xᵢ) where Xᵢ~f_X. SLLN: θ̂→θ a.s. CLT: √n(θ̂-θ)→N(0,Var(f(X))). Standard error = σ/√n. Accuracy ∝ 1/√n r

steps.template_en: Monte Carlo: estimate θ=E[f(X)] by θ̂=(1/n)Σf(Xᵢ) where Xᵢ~f_X. SLLN: θ̂→θ a.s. CLT: √n(θ̂-θ)→N(0,Var(f(X))). Standard error = σ/√n. Accuracy ∝ 1/√n regardless of dimension!
steps.template_zh: 蒙特卡洛：用θ̂=(1/n)Σf(Xᵢ)估计θ=E[f(X)]。SLLN: θ̂→θ a.s.。CLT: 标准误=σ/√n。精度∝1/√n与维数无关！

steps.template_en: Estimate π: generate (U,V)~Unif(0,1)². Count proportion in unit circle: π̂ = 4·(count_in_circle)/n. SE = √(π(4-π)/n). For SE=0.001, n≈10⁶ needed. The 'curse' is in the CONSTANT, not the rate.

Variance reduction: (1) Antithetic variates — use negatively correlated pairs. (2) Control variates — exploit known E[g(X)] to reduce variance. (3) Importance sampling — sample from a proposal, weight by f/proposal ratio.
steps.template_zh: 方差缩减：(1)对偶变量。(2)控制变量——利用已知E[g(X)]。(3)重要性抽样——从建议分布抽样，用f/建议比加权。

steps.template_en: Importance sampling: θ=E[f(X)]=∫f(x)p(x)dx = ∫f(x)p(x)/q(x)·q(x)dx = E_q[f(X)p(X)/q(X)]. Choose q with heavier tails than p. Effective sample size ESS=n/(1+CV²(wᵢ)).
steps.template_zh: 重要性抽样：选尾部更厚的q。有效样本量ESS=n/(1+CV²(wᵢ))。

steps.template_en: (1) Estimate P(X>5) for X~Exp(1) using MC with n=1000. (2) Use importance sampling with Exp(0.2) proposal — compare variance. (3) Estimate ∫₀¹ cos(πx/2)dx. (4) Use antithetic: pair U and 1-U. Compare variances.
steps.template_zh: (1)估计Exp(1)的P(X>5)。(2)用Exp(0.2)建议的重要性抽样——比较方差。(3)估计积分。(4)用对偶变量：配对U和1-U。比较方差。

steps.template_en: MC beats numerical integration in high dimensions. Quadrature: error ∝ n^{-2/d} (exponential in d). MC: error ∝ n^{-1/2} (independent of d). For d>4, MC is faster. 'The integral is the expected value, and the Monte Carlo method just computes it.'
steps.template_zh: 高维中MC胜过数值积分。求积：误差∝n^{-2/d}(d的指数)。MC：误差∝n^{-1/2}(与d无关)。d>4时MC更快。
